# openmetadata_team (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata team. Teams are the organisational units of OpenMetadata: they own assets, group users and carry policies and default roles. A team without parents is placed under the Organization team by the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_policy" "team_policy" {
  name = "platform-team-policy"

  rules = [{
    name       = "view-all"
    effect     = "allow"
    operations = ["ViewAll"]
    resources  = ["table"]
  }]
}

resource "openmetadata_role" "data_steward" {
  name     = "platform-data-steward"
  policies = [openmetadata_policy.team_policy.name]
}

# The root of the hierarchy. A team created without parents is placed under
# Organization, so declare the business unit first and nest everything below it.
resource "openmetadata_team" "engineering" {
  name      = "engineering"
  team_type = "BusinessUnit"
}

resource "openmetadata_team" "platform" {
  name         = "platform"
  display_name = "Platform"
  description  = "Owns the platform services and their metadata."
  team_type    = "Group"
  email        = "platform@example.com"
  is_joinable  = false

  parents       = [openmetadata_team.engineering.name]
  policies      = [openmetadata_policy.team_policy.name]
  default_roles = [openmetadata_role.data_steward.name]
  users         = ["jane.doe"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name. Changing it replaces the team, because the name is part of its fully qualified name.
- `team_type` (String) Kind of team: Department, Division, BusinessUnit or Group. The server validates the hierarchy, so a Department may sit under a Division, BusinessUnit or Organization. Patchable in place.

### Optional

- `default_persona` (String) Fully qualified name of the persona the team's users land on by default.
- `default_roles` (Set of String) Fully qualified names of roles granted to the team's users by default.
- `description` (String) Markdown description of the team.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.
- `email` (String) Contact email of the team.
- `is_joinable` (Boolean) Whether users may join the team themselves. The server defaults it to true.
- `parents` (Set of String) Fully qualified names of the parent teams. An omitted set places the team under Organization. When set, at least one parent is required.
- `policies` (Set of String) Fully qualified names of policies assigned to the team.
- `users` (Set of String) Names of the users that belong to the team.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name. For a team this equals name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_team.platform 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by name, which for a team is also its fully qualified name.
terraform import openmetadata_team.platform platform
```
